heldout_maps: same frozen v1 source-run splits; new episode seeds are not new geometry or new real runs
common_v2_changes: finite observed 60s task deadline is a terminal failure
per-episode navigation-slot permutation independent of task and fault RNG
continue candidate carries observable active-route features

anchored_changes.auxiliary_data: same train-only BT labels as BC, stratified by action class

causal_scope: Bundled optimization comparison. Does not isolate each of timeout, encoder separation, learning rate or BC constraints as a single cause.
test_policy: evaluate each fixed final checkpoint once; do not choose a best checkpoint from test results
runtime: CPU two threads, no ROS or GPU jobs
scope: local observed-support calibrated task proxy, no match combat or economy and no live Nav2 training

common_BC.sampling: equal represented navigate/recover/continue/hold class probability, with replacement
